title: Once the heap holds k items, its top is the k-th best so far
caption: The 3 smallest of a stream, with a max-heap of size 3. The top is the largest value kept, so it's the first to go.

frames.text: Fill the heap with the first k = 3 values: 7, 10 and 4. The top is 10.
3 < 10, so 3 belongs among the smallest. Evict the top (10) and push 3. The new top is 7.
20 and 15 are both > 7, the top, so they can't be among the 3 smallest. Ignore them, with no heap work.
1 < 7: evict 7 and push 1. The top, 4, is the 3rd smallest value seen.
